message:
jordan: FYI new deal - AtlasPay wants to migrate from CloudPrompt to Redwood. They need an in-prod POC to prove parity and meet SOC2/infra reqs. Can we map out a minimal interop plan?
lee: Timeline? Are they asking for a full adapter or just a compatibility shim for their front-end?
morgan: AtlasPay said they currently hit a /generate endpoint with a prompt + metadata, expecting X/Y fields in response. Biggest asks: prompt parity, deterministic reruns for billing, and identical error shapes for our SDK swap.
jordan: Goal is swap-without-rewrite for their payments pipeline. They run ~200 rps bursty, sensitive to latency. Also have a security questionnaire and want KMS + VPC peering.
anita: I need the questionnaire now. Send me the PDF or link and I'll flag any non-starters (data residency, audit logs, key separation).
lee: I'll attach the sec questionnaire in the next message. For POC they want 2 weeks sandbox then a staging run. Budget: they asked about cost delta vs CloudPrompt — need rough delta numbers.
morgan: For parity, we should handle: 1) endpoint mapping (path + body) 2) response field mapping/normalizer 3) deterministic sampling seeds 4) rate-limit headers and 429 behavior 5) error schemas.
jordan: Can we do a quick shim proposal: lightweight proxy that rewrites CloudPrompt requests to Redwood API and post-processes responses to CloudPrompt shape? That would keep their app unchanged.
oliver: Yep. We can ship a proxy. Basic mapping example:
```
# CloudPrompt -> Redwood mapping (pseudo)
POST /generate  {"prompt": "...", "max_tokens": 256, "meta": {...}}
-> POST /v1/outputs  {"input": "...", "options": {"max_tokens":256}}
# Response map: {"text": "..."} -> {"output": [{"content":"..."}], "usage": {...}}
```
morgan: Also need to consider token accounting differences: CloudPrompt includes prompt+resp in billed tokens; our hosted pricing is per-input+output tokens but formats differ. Sales needs a delta example (10k prompts/day).
lee: @morgan can you draft a pricing delta table for the POC? Just ballpark extra/$ savings across quantization + batching assumptions.
morgan: Will do this afternoon. Quick note on SLOs: AtlasPay requires 99.95 latency target p95 under steady state. We should propose Dedicated or a pinned pool for demo to hit that.
jordan: They also want consistent responses for test replays (determinism). Does Redwood support deterministic seeds across model versions?
oliver: Determinism is tricky across model versions. We can support seed-based sampling for a given model+temp, but when we fallback to quantized variants behavior will vary. For POC, lock a specific model version and provide seed + top_k/control to reproduce. Add a regression check in the eval harness.
anita: Security blockers: VPC peering yes, per-tenant logs to their SIEM via syslog, KMS integration (bring-your-own key), and support for E2E encryption of stored cache. If any of those are missing it's a deal risk.
jordan: Good call. What's our current status on BYOK and syslog?
morgan: BYOK supported for Private and Dedicated, not for hosted (we can offer an enterprise hosted with KMS integration — need legal signoff). Syslog forwarding is available via Redwood Console for Dedicated and Private.
lee: AtlasPay requires a signed DPA and subprocessor list before POC. Legal needs to queue that. @lee I'll ping legal.
jordan: For the POC checklist I propose: 1) Security questionnaire answered 2) Sandbox proxy deployed 3) Pricing delta + POC estimate 4) Determinism regression suite with 50 golden prompts 5) SLA / capacity commit for staging
morgan: Adding: 6) Failover policy mapping (how do we present 503 vs CloudPrompt 504?) 7) Tokens billing example for 10k daily prompts at median 80 tokens in and 120 out.
anita: I'll start the sec review and flag anything that requires architecture changes.
oliver: I'll build an initial shim repo with a Dockerized proxy + example mapping and a test harness to run replays. ETA 3 working days.
sre-bot: deploy-bot: sandbox cluster for atlaspay-poc created in us-west-2 (cluster id: rwd-sbx-19720). Access: engineers + legal_readonly.
jordan: Perfect. Lee: can you lock calendar with AtlasPay for kickoff demo Wed 09:00 PT?
lee: Done, invited. Agenda: architecture overview, security Qs, pricing, timeline.
morgan: I'll circulate the pricing delta and a one-page POC runbook before the kickoff.
anita: Shared questionnaire uploaded to <https://redwood.internal/secq/atlaspay>. Please add any controls you need reviewed.
jordan: Thanks team. Next steps: oliver -> shim + harness; morgan -> pricing + runbook; anita -> sec review; lee -> legal + kickoff. I'll be the point of contact for AtlasPay. :white_check_mark: :rocket:
lee: small ask from sales — include a line on rollback plan if parity fails (we should support a quick switch-back to CloudPrompt). Keeps procurement happy.
oliver: I'll add a rollback toggle to the proxy that routes back to CloudPrompt endpoints; toggle controlled by feature flag + header.\jmorgan: noted (typo correction)
morgan: haha noted.
jordan: Closing thread, will post updates after oliver's PR and the pricing doc.
